Mini-gate G4.6 review: Phase 4, group 6 (layout and keyboard) for stories S-5 and S-8 — the LAST group, so from here the full gate applies. Follow your agent instructions. Append a dated "G4.6" section to docs/process/review-findings.md (use Edit; keep earlier sections). Read decision-log D-59 and D-60.

Scope: commits 04de524 (owner-approved D-59 test fix), 446b087 (src/ui: BreakAfterCommas.tsx, ResultsSummary.tsx, HistoryEntry.tsx, app.css), 525e012 (D-60).

IMPORTANT: run Playwright with `CI=1`, and never run it while anything else is running Playwright. Leave nothing on port 4173.

1. Gate (full, per your instructions from G4.6 on): `CI=1 npm run verify`. Developer reports exit 0: Vitest 297/297, size 85.4 KB, E2E 453/453 (3 browsers, incl. your 6 REVIEW tests), `trace --results` OK with 94/94 v1 ACs passing. Reproduce and paste the summary lines + exit code.
2. Freeze check vs tag g3-tests-approved: authorised changes are exactly 749144e (D-46), 5751988 (D-48), 16c8cc8 (D-54/D-55), 04de524 (D-59). Verify 04de524 changes only the one AC-8.1 assertion and that the replacement still rejects focus on any other page element.
3. Conformance: §8.1 layout and breakpoints (side by side ≥ 769 px, single column ≤ 768 px, max width 1200, no horizontal page scroll ≥ 360 px), 44×44 tap targets, §8.2, focus ring ≥ 2 px in both themes, AC-8.1 tab order with results + entries, AC-8.6 keyboard-only session; that `<wbr>` changed no textContent or accessible name (check summary dd textContent and the Restore/Delete names).
4. Exploratory: every page state at 320, 360, 768, 769, 1280 and 1920 px and at 180 px (200% zoom), in both themes: horizontal overflow, clipped text, overlapping controls (bounding-box overlap checks), the dialog at 180 px, very long history lines; keyboard-only full flow in all 3 browsers; Windows high-contrast / forced-colors emulation (`page.emulateMedia({ forcedColors: 'active' })`) — focus ring and buttons still visible?; reduced motion is irrelevant (no animation) — confirm. Turn REAL defects into failing `[REVIEW-n]` tests; delete probes that found nothing.
5. Whole-app code quality pass (Minor unless it risks wrong data, a crash or an a11y failure).

End with `BLOCKING FINDINGS: <count>`. Do not edit src/ or any frozen test.

82-### D-01 Three roles
83-- **Proposal:** R-1 Prospective Borrower (decides whether to borrow), R-2 Loan Advisor (quotes customers professionally: speed, precision, recall, privacy), R-3 Existing Borrower (tracks a loan already running).
84-- **Why:** Their needs differ, and those differences explain why history, delete, keyboard speed and the schedule exist. One "user" role could not justify those stories.
85-- **Alternative:** Two roles (drop R-3). This saves no build work, because the schedule is needed anyway, but it weakens the product story.

88-- **Proposal:** Loan amount 1,000 to 1,000,000,000 (up to 2 dp); rate 0 to 50% (up to 2 dp); tenure 1 to 40 years or 1 to 480 months (whole numbers).

533:### D-59 Post-G3 fix: portable AC-8.1 assertion (owner-approved change to a frozen test)
534-- **Defect (G45-4):** in `e2e/s08-keyboard.spec.ts`, `[AC-8.1] Tab order on a first visit` asserts `expect(resetBtn(page)).not.toBeFocused()` after pressing Tab past Reset, the last tabbable control. Playwright's Firefox keeps focus on the last element in that case, while Chromium and WebKit move it to `BODY`. This was shown on a neutral page by both the developer and the reviewer. The line tests browser behaviour, not the app.
535-- **Decision (owner, 2026-10-18):** replace only that line with a portable check: after the Tab, focus is on Reset or has left the page content (`body` or `document`), but is **not on any other element of the page**. The `clearAllBtn not.toBeFocused()` check before it stays. The `test-designer` makes the edit, and the owner sees the diff.
536-- **Rejected:** removing the line (it loses the "no unexpected focus" check); leaving it failing (S-8 could never be Implemented).

539:Every S-5 and S-8 test already passed before group 6, apart from the D-59 Firefox issue. So group 6 fixed the layout findings from earlier reviews instead:
540-1. **D54-2, Calculate clipped at 200% zoom:** button rows (`.actions`, history `.entry-actions`) wrap instead of overflowing.
541-2. **Narrow viewports:** below 300 CSS px (360 px at 200% zoom = 180 px), tenure and unit stack, and page and card padding tighten. 360 px and up look unchanged. The history entry's non-wrapping buttons had pushed the page to 234 px at 180 px wide; it's now 180/180 in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, with no clipped buttons. This is beyond the spec's 360 px requirement and WCAG's 320 px reflow, but it's a real case (phones at 200% zoom).
542-3. **D54-3, figures broke mid-number:** a `<wbr>` after every comma in the summary figures and history lines, via `BreakAfterCommas`. Long amounts now wrap between digit groups. `<wbr>` adds no text, so `textContent`, the `getByLabel` names and the D-29 button names are unchanged. `overflow-wrap: anywhere` stays as a last resort.

### The Firefox AC-8.1 failure: the developer's claim is confirmed
Own neutral-page probe (`<input><button>one</button><button>last</button>`, focus the last button, press Tab, report `document.activeElement`), run in all three browsers:
`chromium BODY`, `firefox BUTTON#c` (stays on the last button), `webkit BODY`.
So Playwright's Firefox does not move focus off the last tabbable element on a page with nothing after it, while Chromium and WebKit do. The app part of AC-8.1 passed in Firefox: all eight stops (Theme to Reset) were reached in order and the disabled Clear all was skipped (the failing line is the later `resetBtn not.toBeFocused`). The tab order is not at fault. This is a test-portability defect in a frozen test (the assertion `resetBtn not focused` after Tab past the end). Only the owner may change it (spec §12.4); a portable form would assert only `clearAllBtn not focused`, or compare against `document.activeElement` being outside the page controls. Until then `npm run verify` stays red in Firefox.

### Test integrity
- `git log -p g3-tests-approved..HEAD -- e2e/ 'src/**/*.test.*' test/ playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts/trace.mjs ':!e2e/review/'`: three commits only, 749144e (D-46), 5751988 (D-48), 16c8cc8 (D-54/D-55), all authorised. None of the group-5 commits (ec76864, 77c3780, 03d8e1d, c0d02c3) touches the scope. Grep of the whole patch for `.skip`, `.only`, `.fixme`, `test.fail`: no hits. No deleted test.

### Conformance
- **§9.2 load:** all four checks run in the spec order (type guard incl. year 2000..9999, `validateInputs`, canonical equality, `emi` equality), then dedupe by id, then `slice(0, 20)`. Non-JSON and non-array return empty; `Decimal` construction is in try/catch. Hostile stores tried in 3 browsers (null/number/string/array/`{}` elements, `{"a":1}`, `"str"`, 200,000 nested `[`, `__proto__`, duplicate ids, `monthlyPayment` `1e999999` and `NaN`, extra keys, year 9999): no throw, no console error, valid elements kept, invalid dropped.
- **§9.3:** `saveEntry`, `deleteEntry`, `clearHistory` all read first or are key-only; duplicate check is against the newest entry as just read; delete is by id; the last delete and Clear all remove the key (probe: key is `null` after deleting 3 of 3 by keyboard); a failed save (probe: `Storage.prototype.setItem` throws) shows the unavailable text and the results still show; a failed delete keeps both entries and shows `history.removeFailed`; the storage listener handles the history key and `key === null`; focus moves to the heading when the focused entry vanishes. Two tabs, interleaved calculate/delete/clear/calculate: final storage has exactly 1 entry (no resurrected entries).
- **§3.2 Restore:** canonical inputs, errors cleared (probe: field in error, Restore, no `aria-invalid`), currency set and persisted, results recomputed, no new entry, focus on the Restore button, then editing makes results stale.
- **§7 and D-29:** every history/dialog string in `copy.ts` matches the deck character for character. **§8.3 dialog:** native `showModal`, Cancel focused, Cancel and Escape (pressed twice quickly, also with a dark colour-scheme switch while open) focus Clear all, Clear focuses the heading, `aria-labelledby`/`-describedby` present. **AC-12.1** keyboard Delete of every entry in turn: focus lands on the next entry's Restore each time, then the heading. **AC-12.5** disabled when empty/unavailable.
- **Layers:** `src/storage/*` imports only `domain` and siblings; nothing imports `ui`. No `any`, no `number` in money (`tenure` is an integer). No `console.*` in the group.
- **Other probes with no defect:** rapid double-click Calculate gives one entry; 25 calculations leave exactly 20 in the list and in storage; Restore with errors showing and with stale results; 360 px with a 10^15 / 74.99% / 1,200-month entry: no horizontal overflow (0 px); a 10,000-entry (1.4 MB) store loads and caps at 20 in all three browsers without error.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| G45-1 | Minor | S-12, spec §8.3 / D-30 | `e2e/review/g45.spec.ts` `[REVIEW-1]`, fails in 3 browsers. Open the Clear all dialog with one saved entry, remove the key from a second tab (list becomes empty, **Clear all** becomes disabled), then press Cancel. `pendingFocus = 'clearAll'` targets a disabled button, `focus()` is a no-op and `document.activeElement` is `BODY` (observed in chromium, firefox and webkit). Keyboard and screen-reader users lose their place. | In `HistoryPanel` effect, if `clearAllRef.current` is disabled, fall back to the heading. |

A stored entry with `createdAt` `9999-12-31T23:59:59.000Z` passes the 2000..9999 year check (UTC) but is shown as `1 Jan 10000, 04:59` in Asia/Karachi (local year used by `formatDateTime`). Needs a tampered store, so low risk; the symmetric case (year 2000 shown as 1999 west of UTC) also exists. | Check the year with local time too (`getFullYear`), or cap at 9998. |
| G45-3 | Minor | S-11, NFR | Every `parseHistory` validates all stored elements before truncating to 20, as spec §9.2 words it. A 10,000-entry store (about 1.4 MB): page load 0.37 s chromium, 0.83 s firefox, 0.95 s webkit; Calculate (re-read plus write) 0.55 s, 0.57 s, 1.8 s (webkit). Also paid on every `storage` event. Not a crash; only reachable by tampering or a bug elsewhere. | Optional: stop validating once 20 valid, unique entries are collected (the result is identical). |

Gate: the developer's "453/453, verify exit 0" did NOT reproduce. `CI=1 npm run verify` exited 1. Lint, format and typecheck were clean, Vitest was 297/297, and size was 85.4 KB. E2E was 452 passed, 1 failed: `[chromium] [AC-8.4] arrow keys and Page Up/Down scroll the focused schedule`. `trace --results` did not run.

Rerun of that one test alone: 3 runs gave pass, fail, pass; 6 more gave pass, pass, fail, fail, fail, fail. It fails more than half the time here.

The app is correct. With waits, scrollTop goes 40, 416, 40, 0, and there is no `scroll-behavior` in `src`. The frozen test samples scrollTop mid-way through Chromium's smooth-scroll animation, so PageUp races. It is a timing flake plus the OS smooth-scroll setting, not an app defect. Verify is still red, though, so D-60's "exit condition met" line is false, and I rated it Blocker (G46-1). Fix options for the owner: add `--disable-smooth-scrolling` to the Chromium launch args in `playwright.config.ts`, or make the test wait for scrollTop to settle. Both are frozen scope and need owner approval. The developer should correct the D-60 claim (G46-2, Minor).

Freeze check: changes after g3-tests-approved are exactly 749144e, 5751988, 16c8cc8 and 04de524. 04de524 changes only the one AC-8.1 assertion. The replacement still fails if focus sits on any page element other than Reset. Focus on body or document passes, as D-59 intends. No `.skip`, `.only`, `.fixme` or `test.fail` anywhere.

Conformance and exploratory: I ran a probe at 7 widths (180, 320, 360, 768, 769, 1280, 1920), in light and dark, across 5 page states, in all 3 browsers. States were history with long entries, validation errors, huge-figure results, stale results, and the dialog open. It found no page overflow, no off-screen or clipped text, no overlapping controls, and no tap target under 44 px (checked at widths 300 and up). The dialog fits at 180 px. In forced-colors emulation, the 2 px focus ring and button borders stay visible in all 3 browsers. There are no animations, so reduced motion is moot. `<wbr>` adds no text, so textContent and the Restore/Delete names are unchanged. Code quality: no `any`, no `console`, no `Intl`, and the layer imports are clean.

I added no REVIEW tests and deleted all probes. Nothing is left on port 4173.
